canvas.$description: Background of an unchecked checkbox control.

canvas-checked-hover.$description: Control background when checked and hovered.

canvas-checked-active.$description: Control background when checked and pressed.

canvas-checked-disabled.$description: Control background when checked and disabled.

canvas-indeterminate.$description: Control background in the indeterminate state.

canvas-indeterminate-hover.$description: Control background when indeterminate and hovered.

canvas-indeterminate-active.$description: Control background when indeterminate and pressed.

canvas-indeterminate-disabled.$description: Control background when indeterminate and disabled.

border-color.$description: Border color of an unchecked checkbox control.

border-color-checked-hover.$description: Control border color when checked and hovered.

border-color-checked-active.$description: Control border color when checked and pressed.

border-color-checked-disabled.$description: Control border color when checked and disabled.

border-color-indeterminate.$description: Control border color in the indeterminate state.

border-color-indeterminate-hover.$description: Control border color when indeterminate and hovered.

border-color-indeterminate-active.$description: Control border color when indeterminate and pressed.

border-color-indeterminate-disabled.$description: Control border color when indeterminate and disabled.

border-width.$description: Border thickness of the checkbox control.

border-style.$description: Border style of the checkbox control.

border-radius.$description: Corner radius of the checkbox control.

indicator-ink.$description: Color of the checkmark and indeterminate bar.

indicator-ink-checked-hover.$description: Checkmark color when checked and hovered.

indicator-ink-checked-active.$description: Checkmark color when checked and pressed.

indicator-ink-checked-disabled.$description: Checkmark color when checked and disabled.

indicator-ink-indeterminate.$description: Indicator bar color in the indeterminate state.

indicator-ink-indeterminate-hover.$description: Indicator bar color when indeterminate and hovered.

indicator-ink-indeterminate-active.$description: Indicator bar color when indeterminate and pressed.

indicator-ink-indeterminate-disabled.$description: Indicator bar color when indeterminate and disabled.

indicator-stroke-width.$description: Stroke width of the checkmark; also the indeterminate bar's thickness.

indicator-radius.$description: Corner radius of the indeterminate bar.

indicator-size.$description: Size of slotted indicator content (checked/unchecked/indeterminate slots); 1em tracks the component's font-size so size variants rescale it.

font-family.$description: Font family for the checkbox label.

font-size.$description: Font size for the checkbox label.

font-weight.$description: Font weight for the checkbox label.

line-height.$description: Line height for the checkbox label.

letter-spacing.$description: Letter spacing for the checkbox label.

gap.$description: Space between the control and its label.

align-items.$description: Cross-axis alignment of control and label.

group-direction.$description: Flow direction of a .zbk-checkbox-group (column or row).

box-shadow-checked-hover.$description: Control shadow when checked and hovered.

box-shadow-checked-active.$description: Control shadow when checked and pressed.

box-shadow-checked-disabled.$description: Control shadow when checked and disabled.

box-shadow-indeterminate.$description: Control shadow in the indeterminate state.

box-shadow-indeterminate-hover.$description: Control shadow when indeterminate and hovered.

box-shadow-indeterminate-active.$description: Control shadow when indeterminate and pressed.

box-shadow-indeterminate-disabled.$description: Control shadow when indeterminate and disabled.

box-shadow-focus.$description: Control shadow in the focus state (in addition to the outline).

cursor.$description: Cursor when hovering an enabled checkbox.

cursor-disabled.$description: Cursor when hovering a disabled checkbox.

transition-property.$value: background-color, border-color, box-shadow, transform, opacity, outline
transition-property.$description: CSS properties that animate on state changes.
